description.en: Tells whether the party has a member of a given position type: it looks through the party list for a member whose character data has that position type. It needs two arguments but only reads the first. No shipped script calls it.
Position type from the character data.

1 if such a member exists, 0 otherwise.
null if the party or player data is not available, the script system is not ready or fewer than 2 arguments are given.

examples.case: Looking for a position type (not found in script_clean/; invented)
